about: How a script word is spelled for the cloned voice (voice.mjs applyLexicon), on top of the Catalyst kit's shared lexicon. The script and the captions keep the word as written; the timings come back onto it. Dotted names are said with 'dot' (the voice says نقطة otherwise), numbers the way a developer says them.
